name: El Gallo
render: const root=ctx.root;const p=ctx.params;const W=Math.max(1,Math.round(ctx.width));const H=Math.max(1,Math.round(ctx.height));const canvas=root.querySelector('#c');if(!canvas)return;if(canvas.width!==W)canvas.width=W;if(canvas.height!==H)canvas.height=H;const g=canvas.getContext('2d');if(!g)return;g.clearRect(0,0,W,H);root.style.backgroundColor='transparent';const TAU=Math.PI*2;const loop=ctx.progress*TAU;const drawImageFit=(asset,mode)=>{if(!asset||!asset.element)return;const img=asset.element;const iw=asset.width||img.naturalWidth||img.width||1;const ih=asset.height||img.naturalHeight||img.height||1;if(iw<=0||ih<=0)return;const s=mode==='contain'?Math.min(W/iw,H/ih):Math.max(W/iw,H/ih);const dw=iw*s;const dh=ih*s;g.drawImage(img,(W-dw)/2,(H-dh)/2,dw,dh);};if(p.backgroundMode==='color'){g.fillStyle=p.backgroundColor;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);}else if(p.backgroundMode==='image'&&p.backgroundImage){drawImageFit(ctx.image(p.backgroundImage),p.backgroundFit);}const clouds=[{x:p.c1X,y:p.c1Y,s:p.c1Scale,seed:0,phase:0,w:1.44,h:0.99},{x:p.c2X,y:p.c2Y,s:p.c2Scale,seed:5000,phase:1.37,w:1.3,h:0.9},{x:p.c3X,y:p.c3Y,s:p.c3Scale,seed:10000,phase:2.91,w:1.45,h:0.85},{x:p.c4X,y:p.c4Y,s:p.c4Scale,seed:15000,phase:4.46,w:1.25,h:1.05}];const drawCloud=C=>{const t=loop+C.phase;const cx=W*C.x/100;const cy=H*C.y/100;const S=Math.min(W,H)*0.36*C.s;const L=Math.max(7,Math.min(28,Math.round(p.lobes)));const rnd=i=>ctx.random(C.seed+i);const nodes=[];for(let i=0;i<L;i++){const a=TAU*i/L;const ph=rnd(100+i)*TAU;const ph2=rnd(200+i)*TAU;const sizeVar=1+(rnd(300+i)-0.5)*p.irregularity;const driftA=Math.sin(t+ph)*0.035*p.motion+Math.sin(t*2+ph2)*0.018*p.motion;const radialWave=Math.sin(t+ph)*0.035*p.motion;const baseR=S*(0.88+(rnd(400+i)-0.5)*0.22*p.irregularity);const r=baseR*(1+radialWave);const x=cx+Math.cos(a+driftA)*r*C.w;const y=cy+Math.sin(a+driftA)*r*C.h;const bulge=S*(0.24+p.lobeDepth*(0.55+rnd(500+i)*0.75))*sizeVar*(1+Math.sin(t+ph)*0.035*p.motion);nodes.push({x:x,y:y,r:bulge,ph:ph});}const valleys=[];for(let i=0;i<L;i++){const A=nodes[i];const B=nodes[(i+1)%L];const ma=Math.atan2((A.y+B.y)*0.5-cy,(A.x+B.x)*0.5-cx);const valleyBase=S*(0.72-p.lobeDepth*0.32);const jitter=(rnd(700+i)-0.5)*S*0.12*p.irregularity;const vr=valleyBase+jitter+Math.sin(t+nodes[i].ph)*S*0.018*p.motion;valleys.push({x:cx+Math.cos(ma)*vr*C.w,y:cy+Math.sin(ma)*vr*C.h});}const contour=[];for(let i=0;i<L;i++){const V=valleys[(i-1+L)%L];const N=nodes[i];contour.push({x:V.x,y:V.y});const dx=N.x-cx;const dy=N.y-cy;const mag=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy));const ox=dx/mag;const oy=dy/mag;const tx=-oy;const ty=ox;const half=N.r*0.72;contour.push({x:N.x-tx*half,y:N.y-ty*half});contour.push({x:N.x+ox*N.r*0.48,y:N.y+oy*N.r*0.48});contour.push({x:N.x+tx*half,y:N.y+ty*half});}g.save();g.beginPath();g.moveTo(contour[0].x,contour[0].y);for(let i=1;i<contour.length;i++){const a=contour[i-1];const b=contour[i];g.quadraticCurveTo(a.x,a.y,(a.x+b.x)*0.5,(a.y+b.y)*0.5);}const last=contour[contour.length-1];const first=contour[0];g.quadraticCurveTo(last.x,last.y,(last.x+first.x)*0.5,(last.y+first.y)*0.5);g.quadraticCurveTo(first.x,first.y,(first.x+contour[1].x)*0.5,(first.y+contour[1].y)*0.5);g.closePath();g.fillStyle=p.cloudColor;g.fill();if(p.outline){g.strokeStyle=p.lineColor;g.lineWidth=p.lineWidth;g.lineCap='round';g.lineJoin='round';g.stroke();}g.clip();const D=Math.max(0,Math.min(40,Math.round(p.detailLines)));g.strokeStyle=p.lineColor;g.lineWidth=Math.max(1,p.lineWidth*0.72);g.lineCap='round';g.lineJoin='round';for(let i=0;i<D;i++){const ni=Math.floor(rnd(1000+i)*L)%L;const N=nodes[ni];const V=valleys[ni];const side=rnd(1200+i)>0.5?1:-1;const bx=V.x+(N.x-V.x)*(0.18+rnd(1300+i)*0.22);const by=V.y+(N.y-V.y)*(0.18+rnd(1300+i)*0.22);const ang=Math.atan2(by-cy,bx-cx);const tangent=ang+Math.PI*0.5;const len=S*(0.075+rnd(1400+i)*0.09);const inward=S*(0.035+rnd(1500+i)*0.045);const sx=bx-Math.cos(tangent)*len*0.5*side-Math.cos(ang)*inward;const sy=by-Math.sin(tangent)*len*0.5*side-Math.sin(ang)*inward;const ex=bx+Math.cos(tangent)*len*0.5*side-Math.cos(ang)*inward*1.7;const ey=by+Math.sin(tangent)*len*0.5*side-Math.sin(ang)*inward*1.7;const bend=S*(0.025+rnd(1600+i)*0.035);const wob=Math.sin(t+rnd(1700+i)*TAU)*S*0.008*p.motion;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(sx,sy);g.quadraticCurveTo(bx-Math.cos(ang)*(inward+bend+wob),by-Math.sin(ang)*(inward+bend+wob),ex,ey);g.stroke();}g.restore();};drawCloud(clouds[0]);drawCloud(clouds[1]);drawCloud(clouds[2]);const floatY=Math.sin(loop)*p.subjectFloat;const sway=Math.sin(loop+Math.PI*0.35)*p.subjectSway*Math.PI/180;if(p.subjectImage){const asset=ctx.image(p.subjectImage);if(asset&&asset.element){const img=asset.element;const iw=asset.width||img.naturalWidth||img.width||1;const ih=asset.height||img.naturalHeight||img.height||1;if(iw>0&&ih>0){const s=(H*0.72/ih)*p.subjectScale;const dw=iw*s;const dh=ih*s;g.save();g.translate(W*p.subjectX/100,H*p.subjectY/100+floatY);g.rotate(sway);g.drawImage(img,-dw/2,-dh/2,dw,dh);g.restore();}}}drawCloud(clouds[3]);const panelFloat=Math.sin(loop)*p.subjectFloat*0.18;const px=W*p.panelX/100;const py=H*p.panelY/100+panelFloat;const pw=W*p.panelWidth/100;const ph=H*p.panelHeight/100;const corner=Math.min(pw,ph)*0.16;g.save();g.translate(px,py);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(-pw/2+corner,-ph/2);g.lineTo(pw/2-corner,-ph/2);g.quadraticCurveTo(pw/2,-ph/2,pw/2,-ph/2+corner);g.lineTo(pw/2,ph/2-corner);g.quadraticCurveTo(pw/2,ph/2,pw/2-corner,ph/2);g.lineTo(-pw/2+corner,ph/2);g.quadraticCurveTo(-pw/2,ph/2,-pw/2,ph/2-corner);g.lineTo(-pw/2,-ph/2+corner);g.quadraticCurveTo(-pw/2,-ph/2,-pw/2+corner,-ph/2);g.closePath();g.fillStyle=p.panelColor;g.fill();g.strokeStyle=p.lineColor;g.lineWidth=Math.max(2,p.lineWidth*0.8);g.lineJoin='round';g.stroke();const label=String(p.nameText||'');const family=p.nameFont||'Arial';let fs=Math.max(12,p.nameSize);g.font='900 '+fs+'px '+JSON.stringify(family);const maxW=Math.max(1,pw-fs*0.8);const measured=g.measureText(label).width;if(measured>maxW&&measured>0){fs=Math.max(10,fs*(maxW/measured));g.font='900 '+fs+'px '+JSON.stringify(family);}g.textAlign='center';g.textBaseline='middle';g.fillStyle=p.textColor;g.fillText(label,0,0);g.restore();

metadata.description: Escena vertical de retrato personalizable: elige una imagen de fondo y un personaje, ajusta su posición y escala, y añade formas orgánicas animadas con colores, contornos y movimiento configurables. Incluye una placa para editar el nombre. La muestra de referencia se publica con autorización expresa del titular. Cualquier otra publicación o redistribución pública requiere permiso explícito del autor o titular de derechos. No se transfieren derechos sobre el personaje ni sobre materiales de terceros.
